mapper.select: SELECT day.*, ssp.name_alise AS sspName, app.name AS appName, app.os_type AS osType, media.media_company_short AS mediaName FROM data_ssp_slot_day AS day LEFT JOIN ssp_slot_info AS ssp ON day.ssp_slot_id = ssp.id LEFT JOIN ssp_app AS app ON app.id = ssp.app_id LEFT JOIN ssp_media AS media ON media.id = ssp.media_id WHERE day.dsp_slot_id = #{dspSlotId} and day.date = #{date} ORDER BY day.id DESC
SELECT day.* FROM data_ssp_slot_day AS day WHERE day.ssp_slot_id = #{sspSlotId} AND day.date = #{inputTime} AND day.dsp_slot_code = #{dspSlotCode}
